fusions.name: Hiss and Bristle
fusions.desc: Bristles and hisses, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Nape Bite
fusions.desc: Bites the nape of an enemy at or below 25% health for 24 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the bite.

fusions.name: Sudden Zoomies
fusions.desc: Darts 2 tiles forward, then increases your movement speed by 40% for 6 seconds. You also gain 8% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Ninth Life
fusions.desc: A blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead. Once every 600 seconds.
